name: Cyberdramon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing 1 of your Option cards in the battle area, it doesn't leave.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Cyberdramon] or [Justimon] in its name or the [CS] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing 1 of your Option cards in the battle area, it doesn't leave.
